data.long_description:
This fully furnished 1-bedroom apartment in Address Harbour Point Tower 1 offers a luxurious living experience in the heart of Dubai Creek Harbour, the residence is situated on a mid floor, providing a partial water view that enhances its serene ambiance.

Key Features:

• Bedrooms: 1
• Bathrooms: 2
• Size: 729.58 sqft
• View: Partial water view
• Floor Level: Mid floor
• Furnishing: Fully furnished
• Kitchen: Open-plan design

Amenities:

• Built-in wardrobes
• Balcony
• Shared gym
• Shared swimming pool
• BBQ area
• Kids play area
• 24/7 security

Residents benefit from the hotel’s premium services and facilities, including concierge and valet parking. The apartment’s location ensures easy access to Downtown Dubai, Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, supermarkets, and restaurants—making it an ideal choice for those seeking luxury and convenience.
